items.question: How much does a website or app cost?
items.answer: Pricing depends on project requirements, features and complexity. Simple landing pages start from $150, web/mobile apps from $500, and complex platforms like SaaS or ERP are custom quoted. Share your requirements for an exact estimate.

items.question: How long does a project take?
items.answer: Simple projects: 3-7 days. Medium projects: 1-3 weeks. Large platforms (SaaS/ERP): 1-3+ months. Timelines are finalized after requirement analysis.

items.question: What are the payment terms?
items.answer: 35% advance before starting, 35% milestone payment at 50% completion, and the remaining 30% after final delivery.

items.question: Do you provide support after delivery?
items.answer: Yes. Every project includes free support after delivery. Ongoing maintenance and feature updates are also available.

items.question: Can you work on an existing project?
items.answer: Yes. We can take over, fix, upgrade or complete existing projects including code reviews and performance improvements.

items.question: How do we communicate during the project?
items.answer: We can communicate via WhatsApp, Messenger, email or scheduled video calls. You get regular progress updates at every milestone.
